mapper.sql: SELECT employee_id AS owner_id, employee_version_id AS object_id, DATE(effective_from) AS current_from FROM employee_version current_row WHERE current_row.status = 'ACTIVE' AND current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) FROM employee_version other WHERE other.employee_id = current_row.employee_id AND other.status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT employee_id AS owner_id, assignment_id AS object_id, DATE(effective_from) AS current_from FROM employment_assignment current_row WHERE current_row.version_valid_to IS NULL AND current_row.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) FROM employment_assignment other WHERE other.employee_id = current_row.employee_id AND other.version_valid_to IS NULL AND other.record_status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT organization_id AS owner_id, organization_version_id AS object_id, DATE(effective_from) AS current_from FROM organization_version current_row WHERE current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) FROM organization_version other WHERE other.organization_id = current_row.organization_id)

SELECT employee_id AS owner_id, attendance_group_assignment_id AS object_id, effective_from AS current_from FROM attendance_group_assignment current_row WHERE current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) FROM attendance_group_assignment other WHERE other.employee_id = current_row.employee_id)

SELECT attendance_group_id AS owner_id, attendance_group_revision_id AS object_id, effective_from AS current_from FROM attendance_group_revision current_row WHERE current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) FROM attendance_group_revision other WHERE other.attendance_group_id = current_row.attendance_group_id)
mapper.select: SELECT 'EMPLOYEE_VERSION' AS object_type, object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from > #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'EMPLOYMENT_ASSIGNMENT', object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from > #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'ORGANIZATION_VERSION', object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from > #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'ATTENDANCE_GROUP_ASSIGNMENT', object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from > #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'ATTENDANCE_GROUP_REVISION', object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from > #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'WORK_CALENDAR_VERSION', work_calendar_version_id, work_calendar_id, effective_from FROM work_calendar_version WHERE calendar_year = YEAR(#{cutoff}) AND effective_from > #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'ATTENDANCE_POLICY_BINDING', binding_revision_id, binding_family_id, effective_from FROM attendance_policy_binding_revision WHERE effective_from > #{cutoff} AND binding_revision_id = ( SELECT earliest.binding_revision_id FROM attendance_policy_binding_revision earliest WHERE earliest.binding_family_id = attendance_policy_binding_revision.binding_family_id ORDER BY earliest.effective_from, earliest.binding_revision_id LIMIT 1)

SELECT 'EMPLOYEE_VERSION' AS object_type, object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from <= #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'EMPLOYMENT_ASSIGNMENT', object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from <= #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'ORGANIZATION_VERSION', object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from <= #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'ATTENDANCE_GROUP_ASSIGNMENT', object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from <= #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'ATTENDANCE_GROUP_REVISION', object_id, owner_id, current_from FROM () candidate WHERE current_from <= #{cutoff}

SELECT 'ATTENDANCE_GROUP_REVISION' AS object_type, later.attendance_group_revision_id AS object_id, later.attendance_group_id AS owner_id, 'EFFECTIVE_FROM_COLLISION' AS reason FROM attendance_group_revision later JOIN attendance_group_revision earliest ON earliest.attendance_group_id = later.attendance_group_id AND earliest.effective_from = ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) FROM attendance_group_revision other WHERE other.attendance_group_id = later.attendance_group_id) AND earliest.effective_from > #{cutoff} AND later.effective_from = #{cutoff} UNION ALL SELECT 'WORK_CALENDAR_DAY', version.work_calendar_version_id, version.work_calendar_id, 'CALENDAR_DAYS_MISSING_BEFORE_CUTOFF' FROM work_calendar_version version WHERE version.calendar_year = YEAR(#{cutoff}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM work_calendar_day day WHERE day.work_calendar_version_id = version.work_calendar_version_id AND day.business_date = #{cutoff})
mapper.update: UPDATE employee_version current_row SET current_row.effective_from = #{cutoff}, current_row.row_version = current_row.row_version + 1, current_row.change_reason = 'IDENTITY_EFFECTIVE_FROM_CUTOVER' WHERE current_row.status = 'ACTIVE' AND current_row.effective_from > #{cutoff} AND current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT earliest FROM ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) AS earliest FROM employee_version other WHERE other.employee_id = current_row.employee_id AND other.status = 'ACTIVE' ) nested)

UPDATE employment_assignment current_row SET current_row.effective_from = TIMESTAMP(#{cutoff}) WHERE current_row.version_valid_to IS NULL AND current_row.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(current_row.effective_from) > #{cutoff} AND current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT earliest FROM ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) AS earliest FROM employment_assignment other WHERE other.employee_id = current_row.employee_id AND other.version_valid_to IS NULL AND other.record_status = 'ACTIVE' ) nested)

UPDATE organization_version current_row SET current_row.effective_from = TIMESTAMP(#{cutoff}), current_row.row_version = current_row.row_version + 1 WHERE DATE(current_row.effective_from) > #{cutoff} AND current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT earliest FROM ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) AS earliest FROM organization_version other WHERE other.organization_id = current_row.organization_id ) nested)

UPDATE attendance_group_revision current_row SET current_row.effective_from = #{cutoff} WHERE current_row.effective_from > #{cutoff} AND current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT earliest FROM ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) AS earliest FROM attendance_group_revision other WHERE other.attendance_group_id = current_row.attendance_group_id ) nested) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_group_revision collision WHERE collision.attendance_group_id = current_row.attendance_group_id AND collision.effective_from = #{cutoff})

UPDATE attendance_policy_binding_revision current_row SET current_row.effective_from = #{cutoff} WHERE current_row.effective_from > #{cutoff} AND current_row.effective_from = ( SELECT earliest FROM ( SELECT MIN(other.effective_from) AS earliest FROM attendance_policy_binding_revision other WHERE other.binding_family_id = current_row.binding_family_id ) nested) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_policy_binding_revision collision WHERE collision.binding_family_id = current_row.binding_family_id AND collision.effective_from = #{cutoff})
